test_array: test pd.array with various data types and dtypes including integers, floats, strings, booleans, and extension arrays
test_array_inference: test pd.array infers correct ExtensionArray types from input data without explicit dtype
test_array_copy: test pd.array copy parameter controls whether underlying data shares memory with input
test_array_unboxes: test pd.array unboxes Series and Index before passing scalars to ExtensionArray._from_sequence
test_array_inference_fails: test pd.array raises or falls back to NumpyExtensionArray when inference is ambiguous
